ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited received a positive update from Crisil Ratings, with its long-term outlook revised from 'Stable' to 'Positive' while the 'Crisil AA-' rating was reaffirmed. This indicates strengthening financial prospects and a potential future rating upgrade, materializing alongside a significant increase in rated bank loan facilities from Rs 1500 crore to Rs 2500 crore. No red flags are apparent; the announcement signals improved credit perception and enhanced financial capacity.
